item.description: Leading figures in Caribbean reparatory justice movement speak out after UK PM announced infrastructure package Offers of debt relief and development assistance from the UK cannot be a replacement for reparations for centuries of slavery, leading figures in the Caribbean reparatory justice movement have said. item.title: Trump no se arrepiente de nada tras la derrota histórica de los republicanos
item.description: Donald Trump no se arrepiente de nada. Ni de la guerra contra Irán , ni de las decisiones que han marcado su segundo mandato, ni de la campaña que ha terminado con los republicanos perdiendo el control de las dos cámaras del Congreso. El presidente compareció este miércoles ante la prensa por primera vez desde la derrota electoral y rechazó asumir responsabilidad alguna por el resultado. «Si yo hubiera estado en la papeleta, habríamos ganado. item.description: Iran celebrates its claimed role in ‘regime change’ amid pressure on Trump to ‘finish the job’ with attack US midterms live – latest updates Iran this week unveiled a huge billboard and banners over Enqelab Square in central Tehran. The billboard pledged in English: “We will kill Trump” – elevating the degree of personal animus with which Donald Trump is viewed in official Iranian circles. The poster depicts the US president behind bars with his head bowed. And in a sense, given the US midterm election results on Tuesday, Iran has indeed killed Trump, or at least the second term of his… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
